behaviors.description: Tie a build sandbox's lifetime to its real launching process.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent build payload/runtime, a separate launcher and a helper-local subreaper.
behaviors.expected: The unflagged build and holding payload survive parent exit; die-with-parent stops both before cleanup. All owned descendants are reaped.

mappings.rationale: Real process lifetime observations distinguish a bound build sandbox from an unflagged survival control.

surface_assertions.rationale: The flag terminates the build and payload when their actual launching process exits.
